evals.name: unicode override
evals.prompt:
Use the markdown skill to edit example.md.

Input:

```markdown
# Layout

```text
docs/
├── guides/
│   └── install.md
└── reference.md
```
```

Requested edit:

Add api.md under reference.md.
evals.expected_output: The edited Markdown keeps the tree in a fenced text block, preserves Unicode box-drawing characters, and adds api.md.
assertions: The tree remains in a fenced text code block.
The output keeps Unicode box-drawing characters such as ├──, │, and └──.
The output does not convert the tree to ASCII markers such as |--, `--, +--, or \--.
